headline: Chattogram court jails madrasa teacher for raping 8-year-old
summary: The 22-year-old teacher is accused of sexually abusing a class two student at a residential madrasa in Boalkhali for over a year.
details: A Chattogram court has sent a 22-year-old madrasa teacher, Aziz Ullah, to jail on charges of raping a male student in Boalkhali upazila.
The victim, an eight-year-old boy in class two, was a student at a residential madrasa in the area.
Police report that the teacher had allegedly been sexually abusing the child for a year before the matter came to light on Saturday.
The abuse was discovered after the boy fell ill and complained of pain, leading him to disclose the details to his family members.
Following the disclosure, police detained Aziz Ullah from the madrasa on Saturday night.
Additional Superintendent of Police Md Sirajul Islam stated that the suspect was produced before the court under Section 54 of the CrPC as the victim's family has not yet filed a formal case.
The suspect remains in custody as investigations continue.
caption:
A 22-year-old madrasa teacher has been jailed for the alleged rape of an 8-year-old student.

A Chattogram court has sent a 22-year-old madrasa teacher, Aziz Ullah, to jail on charges of raping a male student in Boalkhali upazila.

The victim, an eight-year-old boy in class two, was a student at a residential madrasa in the area.

Police report that the teacher had allegedly been sexually abusing the child for a year before the matter came to light on Saturday.

The abuse was discovered after the boy fell ill and complained of pain, leading him to disclose the details to his family members.

Following the disclosure, police detained Aziz Ullah from the madrasa on Saturday night.

Additional Superintendent of Police Md Sirajul Islam stated that the suspect was produced before the court under Section 54 of the CrPC as the victim's family has not yet filed a formal case.

The suspect remains in custody as investigations continue.

headline_marked: Toss win: [[Bangladesh opt to bowl first]] in Zimbabwe ODI opener
headline: Toss win: Bangladesh opt to bowl first in Zimbabwe ODI opener
summary: Captain Mehidy Hasan Miraz makes the call to field first at Harare Sports Club as the Tigers look to bounce back from a Test defeat.
details: Bangladesh captain Mehidy Hasan Miraz won the toss and elected to bowl first in the opening ODI of the three-match series against Zimbabwe at the Harare Sports Club on Monday.
The Tigers are entering the match with a strong desire to recover from a heavy innings-and-85-run defeat in the one-off Test match.
Despite the recent Test setback, Bangladesh has enjoyed a successful run in ODI cricket, winning four consecutive bilateral series.
This success includes a recent 2-1 home series victory over Australia last month.
However, the team's previous ODI tour of Zimbabwe in 2022 was a challenge, with Bangladesh losing the series 2-1 in Harare.

The Bangladesh playing XI includes Tanzid Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Najmul Shanto, Towhid Hridoy, Nurul Sohan, Mosaddek Saikat, Mehidy Miraz, Rishad Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, and Nahid Rana.
